final: WITH st AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS a FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), base AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS b FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(st.a) AS mean_of_station_avgs, AVG(st.a - base.b) AS mean_excess FROM st, base WHERE st.a > base.b
